app.name: MVS
common.copyFailed: Couldn't copy. Select the link and press <kbd>Ctrl+C</kbd>.
core.down.title: MVS can't run right now
core.down.missing: Part of the installation is missing. Reinstalling MVS should fix it.
core.down.startFailed: MVS couldn't start its engine. Trying again automatically.
core.down.crashed: MVS hit a problem and is restarting. This takes a moment.
core.down.crashLoop: MVS failed several times in a row. Trying again every 30 seconds; if it keeps happening, reinstalling may help.
core.down.keyring: No system keyring found. On Linux, MVS needs a service like gnome-keyring or KWallet.
core.down.logsNote: The logs may show which servers you use. Check them before you share them.
error.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
onb.language.title: Choose a language
onb.language.hint: You can change it any time in Settings.
onb.agreement.title: Before we start
onb.agreement.item1: The app is provided as is, without warranty.
onb.agreement.item2: There is no central server: we don't hold or see your messages and files.
onb.agreement.item3: Whoever shares content is responsible for it. Don't share illegal content or content that infringes copyright.
onb.agreement.item4: Each server's owner and moderators are responsible for moderation there.
onb.agreement.item5: A server listed in public search follows the search rules and may be removed from it.
onb.agreement.item6: Crash reports are only sent with your consent.
onb.agreement.item7: Enter your real date of birth. Under 16 you may not use the app, or enter servers limited to an older age.
onb.agreement.accept: I have read and accept these terms
onb.country.title: Country
onb.country.hint: We took this from your computer's settings. Change it if it's wrong.
onb.country.label: Country
onb.dob.title: Date of birth
onb.dob.hint: It stays encrypted on this device and is never sent. Servers only get an age confirmation, not the date.
onb.dob.invalid: That date doesn't look right. Check the day, month and year.
onb.blocked.title: A little early
onb.blocked.body: For now the app is for people aged 16 and over. We'd love to see you when the time comes.
onb.preparing.title: Preparing your account…
onb.words.title: Your recovery words
onb.words.warning: These 12 words are your account. Whoever holds them controls the account. We don't keep them and can't recover them.
onb.words.tip: Write them on paper, in order, and keep it somewhere safe. Don't photograph them or send them to anyone.
onb.check.tooMany: Too many tries. Show the words again and check once more.
onb.words.authCancelled: Verification was cancelled, so the words aren't shown. Try again.
onb.words.loadError: Couldn't show the words. Try again.
onb.words.writtenHint: Show the words and write them on paper first.
onb.words.revealHint: Make sure nobody can see your screen and it isn't being streamed.
onb.words.english: The words are always in English: it's the standard list for recovery words.
onb.check.title: Quick check
onb.check.hint: To make sure you saved them correctly, enter these words.
onb.check.wrong: {count, plural, one {Word ⁨{positions}⁩ doesn't match} other {Words ⁨{positions}⁩ don't match}}. Check what's on your paper.
onb.check.laterNote: Until your words are checked you can't create a server. A reminder stays at the top of the screen.
onb.profile.title: What should we call you?
onb.restored.title: Your account is restored
onb.restored.servers: Your servers don't come back automatically yet. To return to a server, open an invite link to it – from another of your devices, or ask someone in the server. You'll be recognized as the same account, with your role.
onb.profile.hint: Members of your servers see this name. You can change it any time.
onb.profile.name: Display name
onb.profile.codeHint: This code is shown next to your name, so it's hard for anyone to pretend to be you.
restore.title: Restore your account
restore.hint: Enter your 12 recovery words in order. You can also paste all of them into the first box.
restore.invalid: {count, plural, one {Word {positions} isn't recognised} other {Words {positions} aren't recognised}}. Check the spelling.
banner.recovery: Your recovery words haven't been checked yet. You need to check them before creating a server.
rail.label: Servers
unread.label: New messages
mentions.label: {count, plural, one {# mention} other {# mentions}}
update.waitingForCall: Update ready – installs when the call ends
update.rolledBack: The update to ⁨{failed}⁩ didn’t start properly, so version ⁨{running}⁩ is back.
home.title: Welcome
home.subtitle: You're not in any servers yet. Create one, or join with a link from friends.
home.subtitleWithServers: Your servers are in the side bar. You can also create a new one or join another.
home.create.title: Create a server
home.create.body: Your own community, with a general channel ready to go.
home.join.title: Join with a link
home.join.body: Got an invite link? Paste it here.
create.title: Create a server
create.name: Server name
create.age.none: No limit beyond the minimum age (16)
create.age.hint: You can change it any time. It's shown on the invite page and the server page.
create.needCheck: Before creating a server, check your recovery words – they also protect your ownership of the server.
create.error.name: Give the server a name.
name.invalidChars: The name contains characters that can't be used in names.
create.done.title: Your server is ready
create.done.body: Here's the invite link. Send it to friends.
join.title: Join a server
join.searchingHint: This can take a few seconds.
join.nobody: Nobody from the server is online right now. We'll keep looking in the background, and the server will appear as soon as someone connects.
join.invalid: That doesn't look like an invite link. Check it was copied in full.
join.ageBlocked: This server is for ages {age} and over, so you can't join it.
server.settings.name: Server name
server.settings.ageReadOnly: Changing the age limit is coming in a later version.
server.close.hint: Closing the server ends it for everyone, for good.
server.close.title: Close ⁨{name}⁩ for good?
server.close.body: Nobody will be able to send messages, join it or enter a call there again, and it can't be reopened. Everyone can still read it for 30 days; after that it no longer shows in the app.
server.close.typeName: To confirm, type the server's name: ⁨{name}⁩
server.leave.title: Leave ⁨{name}⁩?
server.leave.body: You'll stop getting its messages and it leaves your server list. You can come back with a valid invite link.
server.updateNeeded: Some members use an older version of MVS, so this can't be done yet. Nothing was changed.
server.updateNeeded.remedy: Ask them to update MVS, or remove them from the server, then try again.
server.updateNeeded.remedyMember: Ask them to update MVS, then try again.
server.closedBanner: The owner closed this server. You can still read it for 30 days, but no new messages can be sent.
server.gone.closed: ⁨{name}⁩ was closed 30 days ago and no longer shows in the app.
invite.none: No invite link is open. Create one below.
invite.revokeConfirm: Revoke this link? No one can join with it after this.
channels.label: Channels
channelOrder.notAllowed: Only the owner can change the channel order. It went back to how it was.
call.label: Voice call
call.noMic: No microphone: you can listen, and others see you as muted.
call.rejoinToTalk: To talk, leave and join again.
call.ipNotice.title: Before your first call
call.ipNotice.body: In a call, computers connect directly, so the other participants can see your IP address.
call.peerRefusedHint: The connection didn't pass a security check, so it was blocked. You can't hear each other.
call.error.full: The call is full: up to 5 people.
call.error.relayOnly: Calls are off in relay-only mode: in a call, computers connect directly and participants can see your IP address.
call.error.inCallElsewhere: You're already in this call on another computer. Leave it there to join from here.
call.error.notImplemented: Calls aren't available in this version yet.
call.error.notAllowed: You can't join this voice chat.
call.error.other: Couldn't join the call. You can try again.
channel.name: Channel name
channel.adultNeeds18: Only people 18 or older can mark a channel as adults-only.
channel.error.nameTaken: There's already a channel with this name.
channel.cannotDeleteDefault: The server's first channel can't be deleted, but you can rename it.
channel.delete.title: Delete ⁨#{channel}⁩?
channel.delete.body: The channel and all its messages are deleted for everyone, on computers running a normal version of MVS. This can't be undone.
chat.empty: This is the start of ⁨#{channel}⁩. Write the first message.
chat.deleteConfirm: Delete this message? It's removed for everyone running a normal version of the app.
chat.state.pending: Waiting – sends when someone from the server connects
chat.state.heldFailed: Not sent: you don't have access to this channel yet – this usually happens just after joining
chat.offline: Nobody from the server is online right now. You can read what's already saved here and write – messages will send when someone connects.
members.label: Server members
connection.direct.title: Connected directly (for example, on the same network)
connection.relay.title: Connected through an MVS relay. It passes encrypted messages along and can't read them.
profile.codeHint: Compare this code to make sure it's really the same person.
profile.blockHint: Messages from blocked people are hidden for you.
profile.kickConfirm: Remove ⁨{name}⁩ from the server? The server's encryption will be updated so they can't read new messages.
notice.encryptionRenewed: Encryption was updated. Whoever was removed can't read new messages.
settings.title: Settings
privacy.relayOnly.label: Relay only
privacy.relayOnly.hint: All connections go through the MVS relay, so others in the server don't see your IP address. The relay itself still sees it. Messages may arrive a little more slowly.
privacy.relayOnly.calls: Voice calls are off while this is on, because calls connect computers directly. If you're in a call, turning this on ends it.
privacy.relayOnly.confirm: Your call will end. Turn it on?
profile.edit.publishHint: Everyone in your servers sees your name. For now, your picture and bio are seen only on this computer.
profile.edit.saveError: Couldn't save your profile. Try again.
profile.edit.charsLeft: {count, plural, one {# character left} other {# characters left}}
profile.image.tooLarge: This image is too large to process (over 25MB). Choose another one.
profile.image.unsupported: Can't open this file. Choose a PNG, JPEG, WebP or GIF image.
signOut.heading: Sign out
signOut.buttonHint: This computer forgets the account. The account itself isn't deleted.
signOut.title: Sign out on this computer
signOut.fact.thisComputer: The account, its servers and messages are removed from this computer only.
signOut.fact.network: The account isn't deleted: the servers and messages stay with the other members.
signOut.fact.words: To sign in again, here or on any other computer, you need the 12 recovery words. Without them the account can't be restored.
signOut.wordsHint: To make sure you can come back, type this account's 12 recovery words.
signOut.noWordsWarning: Without the recovery words, the account can't be restored, on this computer or a new one. Other computers still signed in to it keep it.
signOut.error.other-account: These are another account's words. Use this account's words.
signOut.error.keyring: The system didn't let the account be removed, and nothing changed. Try again.
age.dob.privacy: Stored encrypted on this computer only. Servers only get an age confirmation.
settings.account.notChecked: Your words haven't been checked yet.
settings.language.label: Interface language
settings.theme.label: Theme
settings.scale.label: Interface scale
settings.font.label: Message font size
settings.zoomHint: Shortcuts: <kbd>Ctrl+=</kbd> zoom in, <kbd>Ctrl+-</kbd> zoom out, <kbd>Ctrl+0</kbd> reset.
settings.preview.sample1: Anyone up for a game tonight?
settings.storage.limitHint: When space runs out, old files you haven't viewed are cleared from the cache first.
settings.diag.body: A diagnostics file helps us track down bugs. It doesn't include message text, recovery words or your date of birth.
settings.about.channelHint: Updates always install. You can only choose to get them earlier.
settings.about.licenses: Built on open-source components including React, react-intl and TanStack Virtual (MIT and BSD licences).
chat.clipped: This message is too long, so only part of it is shown
members.lookalikeHint: This name looks like the server owner’s name or like a role. Check the identity code to see who it really is.
onb.profile.avatarTooBig: Pick a PNG, JPEG, WebP or GIF image up to 512 KB.
chat.tooLong: This message is too long. You can send up to {max, number} characters.
chat.sendFailed: The message wasn't sent, and your text is back in the box. You can try again.
chat.cantWriteYet: You can't write here yet: waiting for a moderator to renew the channel's encryption key. Your text is back in the box.
chat.notYet: This isn't available yet. Your text is back in the box.
notify.mute.forever: Until I turn it back on
notify.dialog.title: Notifications for ⁨{name}⁩
notify.settings.title: Notifications
notify.settings.desktopHint: When MVS isn't in front. Each server and channel can be set from its menu (right-click).
notify.settings.previewHint: Off: notifications say “New message” without the text.
notify.settings.desktopOnly: Notifications work in the desktop app.
notify.grouped: {count, plural, one {# new message} other {# new messages}} in ⁨#{channel}⁩
